info.title: ELIZA Compatibility Server
info.summary: Classic ELIZA served through provider-compatible HTTP APIs.
info.description:
A standalone ELIZA server exposing OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Ollama-compatible endpoints.
Development documentation preview; hosted access is not live yet.
